<!--
This checklist IS the review gate. Publishing a post = merging this pull request.
Nothing goes live until a reviewer approves and the boxes below are ticked.
Delete any section that doesn't apply (e.g. if this isn't a content change).
-->

## What's in this change

<!-- One or two lines. For a post: the title and what it's about. -->

## Type

- [ ] New or edited **post** (content)
- [ ] Site / code change

---

## Author checklist (fill in before requesting review)

- [ ] The post reads well and is spell-checked.
- [ ] Frontmatter is complete: `title`, `description`, `pubDate` are filled in.
- [ ] Links and images work.
- [ ] **Ready to publish:** I set `draft: false`. _(Leave `draft: true` if this
      should be merged but NOT go live yet.)_

## Reviewer checklist (the approval gate)

- [ ] I read the post and it's accurate and on-brand.
- [ ] Title + description are clear (they show up in search + social previews).
- [ ] I'm approving this to go live. ✅

> When the reviewer approves and merges to `main`, the site republishes and the
> post is live within a couple of minutes. Full workflow: see the README section
> **"The publishing workflow"**.
